name: Ruby
certifications: Ruby Association Certified Ruby Programmer Silver
Ruby Association Certified Ruby Programmer Gold

beginner.summary: For programmers new to Ruby, or to programming in a scripting language. Covers installing Ruby 4.0 with mise, irb and ruby -w, objects and literals, numbers and precision, strings and encodings, control flow, arrays, hashes and Enumerable, methods, blocks and lambdas, classes, modules, Struct, Data and Set, exceptions, files, regular expressions, JSON, CSV and YAML, Bundler, and a log-summary command-line capstone.
prerequisites: Has written basic programs or scripts in any language, including variables, conditions and loops
Uses a terminal confidently for navigation, environment variables and running commands
Has a Linux, macOS or Windows laptop where Ruby, Git and an editor such as Visual Studio Code can be installed
outcomes: Install and pin a Ruby version and run, lint and debug scripts with irb, ruby -w and RuboCop
Write idiomatic Ruby using collections, Enumerable, blocks, classes, modules and value objects
Handle errors, files, text and common data formats such as JSON, CSV and YAML safely
Deliver a tested, lint-clean command-line tool that uses Bundler and Minitest

Covers pattern matching, the object model, metaprogramming, refinements, lazy enumerators, equality contracts, Minitest and RSpec, SimpleCov and mutation testing, debugging with the debug gem, RuboCop, RBS, Steep and Sorbet, building and publishing gems, OptionParser and Thor CLIs, subprocess scripting, HTTP clients, threads, SQLite and Sequel, logging and configuration, and a lockfile auditor gem capstone.

outcomes: Use the object model, pattern matching and metaprogramming deliberately and safely
